events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.info: Have the Harlem Globetrotters finally met their match? The Washington Generals and new lineup of rivals step onto the court - hungry for a win, and out to prove it! The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching, you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron.. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric, and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now.

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-Court Access from 1:30PM-2:00PM
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena Box Office is open only on event days. The box office opens at least 2 hours before scheduled door time. Check Facebook and Instagram for the Know Before You Go post with the exact opening time. Does not include UMBC Athletic events. The box office is located at the front of the Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena. Ticket Office windows are located outside, to the right of the main entrance doors.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets can be picked up anytime the Box Office is open. Customers must present a valid photo ID with the purchaser's name.

venues.parkingDetail: Preferred Parking is in the lots located around the arena. Preferred Parking can be purchased in advance for select events on parkwhiz.com. Preferred Parking may be available for purchase on the day of the event, subject to availability

generalInfo.generalRule: Bag Policy: Clear bags no larger than 12"x6"x12" will be permitted into Chesapeake Employers Insurance Arena. Guests who have bags that are not clear or clear bags larger than this size will be asked to return them to their vehicles or discard them. This is in addition to the existing policy that all bags, purses or personal items of any size are subject to search. Diaper bags or Medical bags are allowed to exceed that size limit, but will be searched. This policy is subject to change based on a show's request. Prohibited Items: Bottles or cans, backpacks or clear bags larger than 12"x6"x12", food coolers, outside food/beverages (baby food permitted), pamphlets, product samples, skateboards, rollerblades, bicycles, electric scooters, helmets, chairs, laptop computers, 2-way radios, balloons, permanent markers, spray paint, Cameras: no flash/professional photography, tripods or monopods, gopros, or selfie sticks, Signs/Flags/Banners/Posters: may not be larger than 11" x 17" or attached to a pole/stick Food, beverage, alcohol, cans, bottles, flasks, coolers, drugs, illegal substances Weapons, pepper spray/mace, flares, fireworks Frisbees and beach balls Laser pointers Any noise making devices (i.e. air horns, whistles, drums, plastic horns, etc.) Fireworks, illegal drugs and alcohol Audio/Video recording devices. Weapons and dangerous devices of any kind and any other items deemed unacceptable by Arena Management. The entire venue is cashless. Credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay are accepted at the box office and concession stands. The 200 level does NOT have access via the elevator. They are only accessed by stairs
